Okay let's recap: Warming up the voice is important and helpful for us. It makes our sound good, helps our voices not to tired and damaged and is attractive :) lol

Handy Tips when Warming up the ol' Cockles

  • Give yourself some time, work towards 20 minutes but start with 10 minutes if time is tight. The main thing is not to skip the warm-up before singing and DON'T worry if you sound silly.   • Drink water before and during your warm-up exercises.
